title: Sunrise Foods Ltd. plans a new plant
body: Sunrise Foods Ltd. is a public company that makes packaged snacks. It now plans to set up a new processing plant costing Rs 40 crore. The plant will start earning slowly and is expected to recover its cost only over eight to ten years. The company's profits have fluctuated a great deal in the last four years because of changing prices of raw materials. Its promoters hold 52 per cent of the equity shares and have made it clear that they do not want to lose majority control. The company also pays tax at a high rate. The finance manager has placed four proposals before the board: (1) finance the whole plant through a bank overdraft that is reviewed every year; (2) raise the entire amount by a fresh public issue of equity shares; (3) raise the entire amount by issuing debentures; and (4) use a mix of retained earnings, a limited issue of equity shares and a moderate issue of debentures.
